title: Sell the company you built.
On your terms.
hero.lede: Legacy pairs senior M&A advisors with AI-assisted research to run a confidential, competitive sale process for $1M–⁠$50M companies.

paths.title: Three ways to work with Legacy.
paths.lede: Owners come to us to sell. Operators and sponsors come to buy. Experienced professionals license the platform to build a practice of their own.

items.title: A confidential, competitive sale process.
items.description: Senior advisors recast your numbers, build the buyer universe and run the process from blind teaser to funded close.

items.title: Acquisitions with a clear mandate.

items.title: Your own firm on the Legacy platform.

approach.statement: We help owners turn hard work into lasting value, pairing AI-assisted research with seasoned, human deal craft.

principles.title: Senior advisors on every mandate
principles.body: The advisor who values your company runs the process and sits at the closing table. No hand-offs to junior staff.

principles.title: Research-led positioning
principles.body: We map comps and the buyer universe before going to market, so every conversation and counterparty is prepared with care.

principles.title: Confidential by design
principles.body: Blind teasers, NDA-gated data rooms and staged disclosure protect your employees, customers and suppliers until close.

licensing.title: Build an M&A practice on the Legacy platform.
licensing.body: Two license tiers, one standard of support: exclusive seller leads, research, deal templates and coaching from advisors who still close deals.

cta.title: Thinking about a sale in the next 6–18 months?
cta.body: A 20-minute call to audit your add-backs and map the likely buyers. Confidential, no obligation.
